summary: Typosquat of noblox.js drops and executes remote Windows PE from postinstall
details: noblox-asset.js impersonates the noblox.js Roblox API wrapper, reusing that project's description, author email, repository, and homepage in package.json. The declared postinstall hook (`node postinstall.mjs`) is a heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style string-array + XOR-index) script that imports https/fs/child_process, applies anti-VM and anti-debug guards (checks for VirtualBox/VMware/QEMU/Parallels driver paths, VMware Tools registry keys, and analysis tools such as procexp64.exe, processhacker.exe, ollydbg.exe, windbg.exe; inspects parent process for ts-node.exe/node.exe/yarn.exe), then downloads a Windows executable from https://trlxgames.netlify.app/TRLX.exe via createWriteStream and spawns it on the installer's host. The dropper fires automatically on `npm install` and is unrelated to any Roblox API functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
